# Rules: Settings and changes made from chat

**Covers:** The settings schema and writer, the settings and record tools, config cards: `settings/`, `dashboard/components/settings/`.

How to use this file: read the contents list, then read only the entries your change touches (each line gives the line number where the full text starts). The rules that apply to every change are in the root `CLAUDE.md`. To add a rule, see "Adding a rule" there.

## Rules

- **The calm UI: ONE settings schema, ONE writer, chat changes with Undo, a
  four-item sidebar** (v1.321.0, the calm UI redesign — docs/redesign/BRIEF.md,
  AUDIT.md, APPROVED.md, REPORT.md). SETTINGS: `settings/schema.py` declares
  every setting once (key, label, group of seven, type, tier allow|ask|
  ask-floor with per-VALUE `tier_for`, store config|device|profile, aliases)
  and three things read it: `GET /settings/schema` (the Settings page draws
  every row from it — `components/settings/SettingsHome.tsx`), the daemon's
  `PUT /settings` whitelist (`daemon_keys()`), and the chat tools.
  `settings/writer.py` (`ConfigWriter`, on `platform.config_writer`) is the
  ONE write path — every settings route (iron-proxy, profile share, autonomy
  kill, routing, triggers, skill learning, fleet, MCP, computer use) and
  `PUT /settings/values` (any store, one validated all-or-nothing save) go
  through it: side effects, persistence, ONE `update_settings` ledger row with
  a `setting_restore` Undo, `config.changed`. A new setting is a schema row,
  never a hand-written field. CHAT: `settings/tools.py` — `config_list`,
  `config_set` (allow), `config_change` (ask), `config_change_protected`
  (ask; on the deny floor; carded even in yolo and never offered "Always" —
  `ALWAYS_CARD_TOOLS`), `config_secret`; a call through the wrong tier's tool
  is refused naming the right one. `settings/records.py` — schedules,
  workflows, channels, apps (+ the §6.3 records) as REVERSIBLE tools whose
  `capture_undo` snapshots the record into `record_restore`; the create tools
  gained the same Undo (a card only when an Undo was captured, so direct
  `execute` keeps its old data). All chat-only (`wants_settings` /
  `record_tools_for` arm them — since v1.434.0 from `settings/trigger.py`, outside the cap: see the Wave 2 bullet; the POST lane never arms an ask tier), denied
  under low trust, exempt from the roster pin. Both chat lanes put
  `config_cards` on every turn (`chat_turn.config_cards_from_result`, LOCK-
  STEP), the page renders "Setting changed: old → new [Undo]" (Undo =
  `GET /config/changes/{change_id}` → `POST /undo/{id}`), and
  `GET /config/ledger` is the "Changed here or in chat" panel. SECRETS never
  ride a tool argument in chat: `config_secret` / `channel_connect` /
  `app_connect` return a secure card that posts straight to
  `POST /config/secret` (`settings/credentials.py`: names-only ledger, the old
  value kept encrypted under `__undo__<id>` for Undo; `app.<id>` resolves to
  the vault name the pack launches with and saving it loads the pack); a
  `secret_set` armed in chat is swapped for the card; a key pasted into the
  composer is HELD (`lib/configCards.looksLikeSecret`). The chat sends
  `device_id` (`lib/device.ts`) so a device setting lands on that device.
  SHELL: `lib/surfaces.ts` is the one surface manifest (every route, its
  Everything column, `SIDEBAR_HREFS` = the four items; pins ≤ 3) read by the
  sidebar, `/everything`, the palette and the T2 test — an unlisted route
  fails `everything-v1321`. `components/AppSidebar.tsx` is the persistent
  sidebar (the phone drawer, `components/Sidebar.tsx`, shares its body); on
  the chat surface (`CHAT_PATHS` = `/` and `/chat`) its Chats space is the
  chat page's OWN thread rail, portaled in (`lib/sidebarSlot.ts`) — layout
  only, never a second list. `/` renders the chat page; the old Overview is
  `components/overview/StatusOverview.tsx`, shown as Everything › Status
  (`/everything#status`); the home's one conditional line reads ONE endpoint,
  `GET /ui/status-line` (the chat page must never poll `/sessions/…`, a test
  pins it). Relocated pages live in `components/settings/pages/*` and render
  as Settings sections inside `EmbeddedPage` (their PageHeader becomes an h2);
  their old routes redirect WITH their query (`lib/relocated.ts`); `/kanban`
  is Sessions' Board view. The title-bar model chip and the first-run wizard
  are retired: the composer's model menu is the one selector
  (`ModelMenuBridge` sends "Switch model" there; "Make this my default"),
  and a detected model is a one-tap suggestion (`ModelSuggestChip`), never a
  silent pick. GATES: `dashboard/e2e` (Playwright on Edge; daemon 8807 with a
  FRESH home, Next 8808 into `.next-e2e`) runs T1/T2/T3 and the 390 px no-pan
  probe — `pnpm e2e`; `scripts/lint_redesign.py` runs ruff (E9 + F) and
  ESLint (next/core-web-vitals) on touched files. Pins:
  `tests/test_settings_{schema,writer,chat_tools,records,values}_v1321.py`,
  `tests/test_ui_{visits,status_line}_v1321.py`, `dashboard/__tests__/
  {chat-config-cards,everything,sidebar,chat-sidebar-rail,home,chat-firstrun,
  settings-home,one-primary,route-visit}-v1321.test.tsx`.

- **Settings in Simple is the everyday three** (v1.319.0). `BASIC_KEYS`
  (default_provider, default_model, default_persona) are the only FIELDS
  rendered while `full = advanced || showAll` is false; the section heading
  reads "Which AI answers", the jump index, LocalCapabilities, ContextWindows
  and the DaemonToken card wait for `full`; "Show all settings"
  (`#settings-show-all`) sets showAll. A link INTO the form (`?focus=…` or
  `#settings-…`) sets showAll on mount — the strict-pin hint and other
  pages deep-link to settings the short view hides. Save/Reset/dirty are
  unchanged (one form, one PUT `{values}`). Tests that pin the whole form
  set Advanced (ux-wave4-home-system, ux-wave2-system-memory,
  trust-posture). Pins: `dashboard/__tests__/settings-simple-v1319.test.tsx`
  (4 mutations, all red). Everyday starter wording: FirstRunWizard
  SUGGESTIONS and components/chat/examples.ts (no "markdown", "chatbot",
  "IRS" or "client"). The title bar's ThemeSwitcher is wrapped in
  `components/AdvancedOnly.tsx` (Simple keeps the theme in the drawer,
  Settings and Ctrl K).

- **Wave 2 of the chat-first plan: chat finds the right tool, and every chat
  says which screen it is on** (v1.434.0; groups E and F, each built then
  independently reviewed; the reviewers found 10 more defects, every fix
  red-then-green and mutation-checked).
  - SETTINGS TRIGGER (`settings/trigger.py`, replaces `settings/tools.
    _SETTINGS_WORDS`; `wants_settings()` keeps its API):
    - Built from the schema: every row's label, aliases, option names and key,
      plus the secrets. Built once (`_index`), per-text results cached.
    - A writer arms only with a change cue within ~10 words of the setting's
      words; a question arms the reader `config_list` only.
    - Everyday words (theme, model, persona, browser) count only as
      "the/my/your <word>" after a cue. A two-word option label ("Don't ask",
      "Ask first", "Claude Code") counts only beside a word naming its setting,
      as a switch target, or with "by default". A hyphen-glued word, or a code
      noun after a setting word, does not count.
    - Patterns for shapes the schema cannot say: a model name + "by default",
      "open files in Cursor", "turn off web search", "read your replies out
      loud", "make the app dark/light".
    - ADDING A SCHEMA ROW'S LABEL OR ALIAS WIDENS THE TRIGGER: a row with
      everyday words needs a negative row in the table.
  - PLACES:
    - `config_list`/`config_set`/`config_secret` are armed outside the 6-tool
      cap and the model's tool ceiling, after "adapted" is measured. With Auto
      tools off only the reader is armed. The browser sidebar's `browser_*`
      ceiling still keeps them out.
    - Coding sessions: `_build_harness` (both lanes) passes them as
      `mode.build(asked=)` / `plan_tools(asked=)`, which keep each tool's own
      tier (unlike `extra`, which grants). POST drops the ask tier, plan mode
      and questions get the reader, low trust gets none.
  - CREATE TOOLS:
    - `schedule_create`, `goal_add`, `webhook_add`, `sentinel_add` are
      ask-armed in the STREAM lane only (`ASK_FIRST_CREATE_TOOLS`).
      `chat_turn.ask_first_overrides` writes an "ask" override: never over a
      deny or an explicit "+" pick, and a failed write takes the tool off
      (fail-closed). In chat they always card now, even when set to Run
      without asking.
    - `settings_ask_tools` is the one function the stream lane calls; its
      matching runs off the loop, in the same hop as the saved-workflow-name
      read (≤ 500 rows).
    - `workflow_run` is ask-armed for a run verb + "workflow" or a saved
      name. `records._runs_a_named_workflow` finds each run verb once and looks
      the following words up by length: never one regex per name.
    - New recurring-time shapes count for schedules. "Schedule a
      call/meeting", calendar events, the person's own routine and code nouns
      (webhook handler, watcher function, goal section) arm nothing.
      `sentinel_add` is on the Automation roster.
  - A USER'S DENY HOLDS: `_resolve_armed_tools` drops any tool the user set to
    Never run from every automatic pass. The armed "allow" override used to
    beat a base deny: `config_set`, and older, `write_document` and
    `web_search`. Explicit "+" picks are left alone; no permission engine =
    nothing denied; an engine that raises = nothing armed.
  - LINEAR: three quadratic patterns fixed (`records._NOT_OUR_SCHEDULE`,
    `_RUN_WORKFLOW`, `app_names._WEB_SEARCH_RX`), and `trigger._cue_positions`
    tokenises once. A new regex over user text gets a pathological-input pin in
    a child process with a deadline.
  - DEVICE ID (group F):
    - `BuildTurnBody.device_id` and `BuildAccountChoice.device_id` →
      `start_build_turn(device_id=)` → the turn's `ChatBody`.
    - Try on several models carries it to each attempt (`Plan.device_id`).
      The approved plan's act turn carries the id of the screen that pressed
      Allow.
    - `paneChatCore.buildTurnBody(deviceId)` sends it only when non-empty;
      HarnessSession and `chooseAccountAndContinue` send `getDeviceId()`.
    - Turns Iron Jarvis starts by itself carry none, on purpose.
    - The settings tool refuses a device id the store would reject
      (`settings/tools.BAD_DEVICE_REFUSAL`, `device.valid_device_id`). In the
      browser sidebar (unreachable today: its ceiling) it names the app as the
      place.
  - GITHUB SECRET SCANNING: the repo is public, and made-up test values shaped
    like credentials raise alerts the owner reads as leaks.
    `tests/test_no_secret_shaped_values_v14340.py` fails while a tracked file
    holds a MongoDB Atlas URI with a password, a Google API key or a Telegram
    bot token: use an example.com host, or build the value from pieces.
  - Pins: `tests/test_chat_arming_table_v14340.py` (278 rows + the review's
    rows), `tests/test_chat_arming_review_v14340.py`,
    `tests/test_device_id_{every_chat,review}_v14340.py`. The reviewer's 125
    fresh sentences: requests 65/65 (master 27/65), near-misses arming no
    writer 49/60 (master 27/60).
  - Moved on purpose:
    - `test_roster_coverage_v1178` (sentinel_add left the off-roster list),
      `test_matcher_tables_v13610` (new CODING rows),
      `test_claude_setup_review_v14240`;
    - dashboard exact-body pins: `ij-harness-session-v1369`,
      `harness-continue-session-v1422-0`, `limits-without-a-press-v1393`,
      `pane-chat-v1206`, `browser-ambient-v1236`;
    - `step-target-twin-v1378` (+ fixture), `wave1-paste-guard-v1433`.
  - OPEN:
    - 11 of the reviewer's 60 near-misses still arm a writer ("switch my
      calendar to week view", "make a schedule for my kids' chores", "add my
      API key to the .env file", a theme "on my iPhone").
    - An explicit "+" pick still lifts a deny (consent).
    - `select_ask_tools` and `harness_asked_tools` run on the loop (input
      capped). A denied automatic pick still takes an automatic slot.
    - `sentinel_add` on the Automation agent is allow-tier for unattended runs
      (denied under low trust; watchers stay off until turned on).
    - Not driven with a real model or in the packaged app.

- **Wave 3 of the chat-first plan: projects, agents, apps, destinations,
  goals from Chat, Local only and Undo from chat** (v1.435.0; groups G, H, I,
  each built then independently reviewed; the reviewers found 29 more
  defects, every fix red-then-green and mutation-checked). Every new tool is a
  RECORD tool (`settings/records.py` pattern: ask tier, approval card,
  `record_restore` Undo), lives in its own module, and reaches the lists in
  `records.py` by small additions (`RECORD_TOOL_TIERS`, `_SNAP`, `restore()`,
  `record_tools()`, one arming call in `record_tools_for`).
  - THE UNDO RULE (all three groups): an Undo puts back ONLY what its change
    did; it REFUSES in words (409) when the record was changed again, deleted,
    or re-created since, and never destroys newer work; the card shows the
    daemon's own words about what the Undo did (`ConfigCards` `undoAnswerNote`
    / `undoRefusalWords`). A new record tool keeps a `prior` and the row it
    left (`after` / `_now`) and checks both at restore.
  - PROJECTS + AGENTS (group G, `settings/records_projects.py`, kinds
    `project`, `agent`): `project_create/update/archive/focus`,
    `agent_create/update/pause/delete`. Only through the routes' own bodies,
    lifted to module level (`routes/projects.create/update/delete_project_
    record`, `routes/agents.create/update/pause/resume/delete_custom_agent`,
    `employee_fields`): a reader of these routes calls them, never a copy.
    `project_focus` goes through `ConfigWriter.apply` (its `_project_problem`
    is the one focus rule). A `\\host` folder is refused by its TEXT before
    any disk check. Undoing a `project_create` ARCHIVES the project when
    anything is bound to it (every table with a `project_id`, schedule
    payloads). `agent_delete` records the trash folder in its Undo entry so
    Undo moves the folder back. Built-in agents are refused.
  - APPS + DESTINATIONS (group H, `settings/records_apps.py`, kinds
    `app_removed`, `destination_removed`, `destination_alerts`,
    `app_switched`, and `channel_mode` in `records.py`): `app_switch`,
    `app_disconnect`, `app_import`, `channel_remove`, `channel_alerts`, and an
    email type for `channel_connect` (password on the secure card; a
    `password` argument is refused before any card).
    - A removal keeps an encrypted copy of every key it deletes
      (`__undo__bak_*`, names only in the journal); Undo never writes a key
      over a newer one; `core/db.prune_events` deletes the backups named by
      expiring `record_restore`/`secret_restore` rows (only `__undo__`
      names) — older credential-card backups now expire too.
    - `channel_toggle`'s Undo keeps only the two switches (`channel_mode`):
      no webhook address in the journal any more (old `channel` rows still
      hold one until retention).
    - `app_import` reads other programs' configs (`mcp/import_sources`,
      known source keys only, a network path refused by its text) and adds
      through `routes/agents._apply_specs`; its card is once-only and shows
      the command line (masked) it will start. A server with a placeholder is
      refused and pointed at Settings › Tools.
    - `channel_alerts` says that schedule result lines and workflow notify
      steps reach every destination whatever its alert list.
    - `DELETE /comm/channels/{name}` and the chat share `remove_destination`.
  - GOALS FROM CHAT, LOCAL ONLY, HISTORY (group I, `settings/records_history.
    py`, kinds `goal_contract`, `chat_local_only`):
    - `goal_list` shows goals from Chat; `goal_update`/`goal_delete` act on
      them through `goals/engine.resume_goal`/`delete_goal` (the routes call
      them too). Undo restores the state (and the breaker if tripped), never
      the spend or a finished run; grants come back only for a delete.
    - `chat_local_only` (D3): ON allowed with no card; OFF only through a
      once-only card, `once_reason` "privacy", in every posture and past every
      grant, refused without it; a held chat is never turned off; it applies
      "from your next message" and holds later steer notes
      (`TurnHandle.hold_steers`); a new chat's pick rides
      `egress.note_pending_local_only` until the link route. Setting
      `chat_new_local_only` is read by the chat page only.
    - `changes_list` (names only; a Local only chat's file names withheld
      from cloud turns, `local_only_rows`, fail-closed) and `change_undo`
      (always a once-only card, `once_reason` "undo", then the same
      `perform_undo`; it undoes the change its card named, `_pick_held`).
    - "privacy" and "undo" are SAFETY reasons (`stall.SAFETY_REASONS`,
      `lib/onceReason.ts`): Enter never allows them and they never go to the
      phone. Both tools work only for session "chat" on the chat's own
      surface (`_chat_page_problem`): an agent run, the phone or the browser
      sidebar is refused in words. `config_undo` refuses to undo an ask-floor
      setting (`protected_restores`) and points at `change_undo`.
  - Pins: `tests/test_records_projects{,_review}_v14350.py`,
    `tests/test_apps_destinations{,_review}_v14350.py`,
    `tests/test_chat_history_{tools,review}_v14350.py`,
    `dashboard/__tests__/{record-undo-words-v1435-0,local-only-from-chat-v1435,
    local-only-from-chat-review-v1435}.test.tsx`.
  - Moved on purpose: `test_roster_coverage_v1178` (off-roster list),
    `test_permission_coverage_v1178`, `test_chat_arming_table_v14340`
    (FAMILIES), `test_settings_records_more_v1321` ("undo that" offers
    `change_undo`; two pins moved off Dry-run), `trust-posture-v1298` (the
    low-trust sentence), and the regenerated word tables and fixtures.
  - OPEN:
    - A tool picked by hand in the chat's "+" Tools menu runs with NO card
      (the old "arming is granting" design): `app_disconnect`,
      `channel_remove`, the project and agent tools included; only
      `app_import` forces its card. The owner's call.
    - An agent run's once-only safety cards (git guard, guarded edits) still
      go to the phone as `approval.requested` (Build sessions keep them off
      the phone through `stall.phone_may_ask`; agent runs do not).
    - `config_undo` under Don't ask still re-grants a revoked always-allow and
      undoes record changes with no card (older).
    - Disconnecting an app still deletes a vault row another app shares; the
      Tools page shows a value after a space-separated `--api-key`.
    - Card words for `agent_pause` / `project_archive` do not say which way.
    - Two windows on one chat can overwrite a Local only change.
    - Not tried on a phone or in the packaged app.

- **Wave 4 of the chat-first plan: the night shift, a folder's coding setup,
  model servers, accounts, memory bases, preferences, personas, answer
  language and the desktop's start settings, from chat** (v1.438.0; three
  groups, each built then independently reviewed — the reviewers found 7, 10
  and 14 more defects, every fix red first and mutation-checked). Every tool
  is a RECORD tool on Wave 3's pattern (ask tier unless a reader, a card,
  `record_restore` Undo that refuses in words over newer work, in
  `LOW_TRUST_DENY`, armed only by `records.record_tools_for` → each module's
  own `<area>_tools_for`, both-ways arming tables, linear regexes with a
  child-process pathological-input pin), and `daemon/change_claims.py` knows
  every new kind.
  - GROUP A, `settings/records_build.py`: `night_task_add` (its
    `spend_check` names the live night window and folder; Allow-once card in
    every posture but Don't ask; refused unattended and in a Local only chat
    whose task model, default, try-on or team leaves the network —
    `_local_only_night_problem`), `night_task_list`/`build_folder_show`
    (allow), `night_task_cancel`, `night_task_move`, `build_defaults_set/
    clear`, `build_team_set/clear`. Route bodies lifted: `routes/night.
    add_night_task`/`cancel_night_task`, `routes/team.member_for_model`.
    Folder = the one named, else the chat project's root, else refused in
    words (never "this repo" guessed); `\\host` refused by text first; Don't ask
    and Full access refused. `harness.team.validate(pending=)` checks a team
    BEFORE any model-team member is made. An account is not a folder default
    (said in words).
  - GROUP B, `settings/records_connections.py`: `model_server_add` (Fleet's
    own body; the card says this network vs the internet; key only on the
    secure card `model_server.<id>`; a node id whose vault key row is empty —
    `_fresh_node_id`, else an old key went to a new server; `make_default`
    picks from the server's OWN list), `model_server_default` (says where the
    model answers, `egress.stays_on_this_network(model=)`),
    `model_server_remove`, `account_add` (Iron-Proxy creates it, then its own
    sign-in terminal; never a token; Undo only after `client.refresh` says it
    still needs sign-in), `memory_base_add` (Notion token on the secure card,
    live, or a notes folder; optional memory profile; keeps a token it did
    not make). Any credential-named argument is refused and every shown
    address drops user:pass, query and fragment. Under Local only an
    internet server, Notion or a cloud default keeps its card even in Don't
    ask. `account_groups` from chat is MERGED
    (`merged_account_groups`; `[]` removes a group; `config_list` says so via
    `settings/tools.ACCOUNT_GROUPS_HOW`), names resolved from the CACHED
    snapshot. Route bodies lifted in routes/fleet, connections, iron_proxy,
    knowledge.
  - GROUP C, `settings/records_self.py` + schema: `preference_list` (allow),
    `preference_edit`, `preference_forget`, `lesson_add`, `persona_create/
    update/delete` over lifted bodies (`learning.preferences`, `add_lesson`
    out of POST /lessons, `personas.store.*_persona_record`), promptguard
    on every text, profile share notified; someone else's preference, a
    course's lesson, a marketing persona arm nothing; Undo never duplicates a
    preference or removes a persona that became the default. Profile rows
    `profile.language`, `profile.enforce_language`, `profile.formatting_rules`
    (allow, through the settings tools; a change says so when "Use my
    profile" is off). Desktop rows `start_with_windows` (ON ask-floor) and
    `keep_running_in_background`, nullable; `SettingDef.unset_ok`/`applies`;
    `PUT /settings/values` takes `actor: "desktop"`. `desktop/main.js`
    `readDesktopAppSettings` reads config.toml at start and every 15 s, applies
    a value only when it differs from the last one the shell saw
    (`appSwitchesSeen`), a tray press PUTs it one write at a time per switch
    (`appSwitchesPending`), an Undo back to "not set" restores the shell's own
    earlier switch (`appSwitchesBefore`); dev runs never touch the login item.
  - TESTING TRAP FOUND: a fresh agent worktree's `uv run pytest` used a GLOBAL
    pytest and imported the MAIN checkout's code until `uv sync --extra dev`;
    a worktree's first step is that sync, then check `iron_jarvis.__file__`.
  - Pins: `tests/test_records_{build,connections,self}{,_review}_v14380.py`,
    `tests/_records_build_table_v14380.py`, `tests/test_change_claims_self
    {,_review}_v14380.py`, `tests/test_desktop_start_settings{,_review}
    _v14380.py`, `tests/test_profile_language_rows_v14380.py`; moved on
    purpose: `test_change_claims_v14360` (a preference is a record now), the
    v1178 coverage lists, the regenerated word tables and the three fixtures.
  - OPEN: "Don't ask" queues a night task with no card; a tool picked by hand
    from + Tools still runs uncarded (the owner's open decision); templates
    were not built; no persona reader; an account is not a folder default;
    the open session's own team is not offered from chat; a cloud team member
    named by name passes Local only (only model seats are checked); a mapped
    drive or a junction to a share is still opened by the memory-base folder
